c.title: $4,350 / 2br - 801ft2 - 2 Bed + 2 Bath @ Fourth + Mac — Kitsilano | Available October 1 (Vancouver)
c.description:
Live at Fourth + Mac in this spacious 801 sqft two-bedroom, two-bathroom home featuring city and water views, a private balcony, air conditioning and flexible in-suite storage/worksapce. Located at West 4th Ave and Macdonald Street , Fourth + Mac puts you steps from Fresh Street Market, Shoppers Drug Mart, cafés, restaurants, fitness studios, transit and some of Kitsilano's best beaches.

Home Features
• City + water views
• Full size appliance package
• Individual air conditioning
• In suite flex room for storage or workspace
• Private balcony
• Under cabinet LED lighting
• Medicine cabinet in bathroom
• In suite laundry

Parking Available for Rent

Neighborhood
• West 4th retail, restaurants, cafés, fitness studios
• Easy access to bus routes 44 & 84 (UBC + downtown)
• Beaches within minutes

Building Features
• Zero carbon operations

• Pet friendly

Amenities

• The Lounge — social lounge with big screen TV, pool table, and outdoor patio
• The Roof — rooftop with BBQ stations, dining zone, garden plots, play areas, and lounge spaces
• Dedicated wash room for sandy paws + muddy bikes
• High speed Wi Fi in most amenity spaces
